briefdescription.para: Current execution lifecycle state of the debug target.

detaileddescription.para: Set by the Whatdbg command handlers and drains, and by the engine event paths: the Callbacks.cpp and Session_mac.cpp stop and exit handlers, and Session::pollEvents on Windows for E_UNEXPECTED. Read by Whatdbg::run to choose between polling the engine and sleeping, by Whatdbg::onDisconnect, and by Whatdbg::getEndModeForExit.

briefdescription.para: Cause of the current stop.

detaileddescription.para: See StopReason for the writers of each value.
Read by Whatdbg::processDeferredEvents. A drain resets it to none.

briefdescription.para: Exit code of the debuggee process.

detaileddescription.para: Set by EventCallbacks::ExitProcess (Windows) or onProcessStateExited (macOS). Read by Whatdbg::drainProcessExited for the DAP exited event body.

briefdescription.para: OS process ID of the debug target.

detaileddescription.para: Attach (both platforms): set by Whatdbg::onAttach after Session::attach succeeds — the sole writer for the attach path on both platforms. Launch: set by Session_mac::launch directly (macOS), or by EventCallbacks::CreateProcess (Windows, asynchronous). Used by Session::interrupt / Session::terminateDebuggee.

briefdescription.para: Program path from the launch request; empty for attach sessions.

detaileddescription.para: Set by Whatdbg::onLaunch after Session::launch succeeds. Read by Whatdbg::resumeAfterInitialBreak, where non-empty selects the launch-path process event; attach sessions announce theirs from Whatdbg::onAttach instead.

briefdescription.para: juce::Time::getMillisecondCounter() deadline for the debuggee's exit event after Whatdbg::onDisconnect issues a terminate.

detaileddescription.para: 0 means no deadline is pending.

Set by Whatdbg::onDisconnect. Consumed by Whatdbg::drainTerminateTimeout, which forces run() to exit if the exit event never arrives. Cleared once the debuggee's exit is observed or the deadline is enforced.

briefdescription.para: True while the main loop should continue running.

detaileddescription.para: Set to false by Whatdbg::onDisconnect (also registered for the "terminate" command) to exit run(), by Whatdbg::drainProcessExited once the debuggee's exit has been observed, or by Whatdbg::drainTerminateTimeout when the deadline passes.

briefdescription.para: When true, the debuggee process will be terminated on disconnect.

detaileddescription.para: Controlled by the terminateDebuggee field of the DAP disconnect request.

briefdescription.para: Set to true once the client sends configurationDone.

detaileddescription.para: The initial break is only released after configuration is complete.

briefdescription.para: Set to true between a step request and the corresponding step-complete event.

detaileddescription.para: Set by Whatdbg::onNext, onStepIn, and onStepOut, and cleared by Session::pollEvents on Windows when a wait returns S_OK. Read by Session::pollEvents on Windows and by Callbacks.cpp LoadModule, which does not stop for a module load while a step is pending.

briefdescription.para: Set to true between a pause request and the corresponding pause-complete event.

detaileddescription.para: Set by Whatdbg::onPause. Consumed by Callbacks.cpp onBreakpoint (Windows) and by Session_mac onStopReason (macOS) to classify the next stop as a pause, since a user pause on some liblldb builds reports eStopReasonBreakpoint rather than eStopReasonInterrupt. Cleared once the stop has been classified, and by Whatdbg::onContinue.

briefdescription.para: Engine breakpoint ID that caused the most recent breakpoint stop.

detaileddescription.para: Set with stopReason breakpoint by Callbacks.cpp Breakpoint and Session_mac onBreakpointStop. Read by Whatdbg::drainBreakpointHit and passed to BreakpointManager::getBreakpointStoppedEvent to build hitBreakpointIds.

briefdescription.para: Image file name (full path) of the most recently loaded module.

detaileddescription.para: Set by Callbacks.cpp LoadModule when no step is pending. Read by Whatdbg::drainModuleLoaded and passed to BreakpointManager::onModuleLoad, which reloads that module's symbols when a breakpoint is unresolved.

briefdescription.para: Set by Session_mac onBreakpointEvent when liblldb resolves a new breakpoint location (typically because a matching module loaded after the BP was created).

detaileddescription.para: Consumed by processDeferredEvents to emit a DAP breakpoint event with reason=changed so the client gutter marker flips from unverified to verified.

briefdescription.para: Engine breakpoint ID associated with the most recent resolution event.

detaileddescription.para: Set alongside hasBreakpointLocationsResolved. Caller passes this to BreakpointManager::onBreakpointLocationFound, which scans the breakpoints registry for the matching entryInfo.engineId and returns its DAP breakpoint ID.

briefdescription.para: Resolved source line for the BP whose location was just added.

detaileddescription.para: Set alongside hasBreakpointLocationsResolved. 0 if unavailable (shouldn't happen in practice — LocationsResolved implies a line entry).

briefdescription.para: Set when the target process exits: by Callbacks.cpp ExitProcess (Windows), by Session::pollEvents when WaitForEvent returns E_UNEXPECTED (Windows), or by Session_mac onProcessStateExited (macOS).

detaileddescription.para: Consumed by Whatdbg::drainProcessExited, which emits DAP exited and terminated events and transitions executionState to exited. Cleared after consumption.

briefdescription.para: Platform-native exception/signal code.

detaileddescription.para: Windows: NTSTATUS / SEH exception code (e.g., 0xC0000005 for ACCESS_VIOLATION). Written by Callbacks.cpp onUnknownException on a second-chance exception, and by onBreakpoint for an int3 that is neither the initial break nor a pause. macOS: POSIX signal number from SBThread::GetStopReasonDataAtIndex(0) when stop reason is eStopReasonSignal; Mach exception type when eStopReasonException. Written by Session_mac onSignalStop and onExceptionStop.
Written with stopReason exception. Persists after consumption so that Whatdbg::onExceptionInfo can respond with the exception details.

briefdescription.para: Virtual address at which the exception occurred.

detaileddescription.para: Written with exceptionCode, under stopReason exception. Persists after consumption for Whatdbg::onExceptionInfo's response.

briefdescription.para: Discriminator for how exceptionCode should be interpreted on macOS.

detaileddescription.para: false (default, and always-false on Windows): exceptionCode is a POSIX signal number (SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, …) resolved via signalNames.

true (macOS only): exceptionCode is a Mach exception type (EXC_BAD_ACCESS = 1, EXC_BAD_INSTRUCTION = 2, …) resolved via machExceptionNames. Set by onExceptionStop when LLDB reports eStopReasonException instead of eStopReasonSignal.

briefdescription.para: Set by OutputCallbacks::Output2 (Windows OutputDebugString) or drainProcessStdio (macOS stdout/stderr).

detaileddescription.para: Consumed by processDeferredEvents to emit a DAP output event using debuggeeOutputCategory. Cleared after consumption.

briefdescription.para: Text captured from the target via OutputDebugString (Windows) or SBProcess::GetSTDOUT / GetSTDERR (macOS).

detaileddescription.para: Set alongside hasDebuggeeOutput. Forwarded verbatim in the DAP output event body.

briefdescription.para: DAP output event category for debuggeeOutputText — "console" on Windows (OutputDebugString has no stream distinction), "stdout" or "stderr" on macOS depending on which stream drainProcessStdio last read.

detaileddescription.para: Set alongside hasDebuggeeOutput.

briefdescription.para: Monotonically increasing counter used to generate unique variablesReference values.

detaileddescription.para: Reset to 1 on each stop event via resetVariablesState().

briefdescription.para: Maps variablesReference -> (frameIndex, symbolIndex).

detaileddescription.para: A symbolIndex of -1 means the entry represents the top-level locals scope for the given frame. A non-negative symbolIndex identifies an expanded child variable within the symbol group for that frame.

briefdescription.para: Monotonically increasing counter used to generate unique frameId values.

detaileddescription.para: Reset to 1 on each stop event via resetVariablesState().

briefdescription.para: Maps frameId -> (threadSystemId, frameIndex).

detaileddescription.para: Populated by onStackTrace. Read by Whatdbg::selectFrameFromId, which onScopes and onEvaluate call to restore the thread and frame context before a query.

briefdescription.para: System thread ID of the thread whose scopes were last requested.

detaileddescription.para: Cached to avoid redundant setCurrentThreadBySystemId calls between consecutive scopes requests targeting the same thread.

briefdescription.para: Single Source of Truth for all mutable debug session state.

detaileddescription.para: State is the SSOT shared between Session, BreakpointManager, and Whatdbg. It is registered as a jam::Instance so that any subsystem can resolve it without an explicit pointer argument.

Fields are grouped by concern. The engine event paths write the stop cause into stopReason and its payload fields: Callbacks.cpp on Windows, Session::pollEvents on Windows for steps, and Session_mac.cpp on macOS. Whatdbg::processDeferredEvents reads stopReason and runs the drain for it. All access must occur on the main thread unless a field is explicitly noted otherwise.

simplesect.para: Declared first in Whatdbg so that jam::Instance registration happens before any dependent object is constructed.
